entry.title: BPB Reader Poll Reveals Attitudes Toward AI in Music Software
entry.content:
Links: bedroomproducersblog.com

A poll of over 2,000 Bedroom Producers Blog (BPB) readers shows a preference for AI tools designed for specific technical tasks—such as stem separation, noise removal, and code assistance—while expressing strong opposition to AI music generators. Approximately 89% of respondents support AI-related coverage, but 88% rejected tools that generate finished songs from text prompts.

The results highlight concerns regarding software quality, maintenance, and the ethical use of training data. While some producers utilize AI for specific workflow benefits or accessibility, the consensus favors tools that assist the creative process rather than replacing the musician.

entry.title: JBL Professional Introduces 3 Series MkIII Studio Monitors
entry.content:
Links: musictech.com | jblpro.com

JBL Professional has announced the launch of its 3 Series MkIII line of powered studio monitors, featuring an extensive redesign of the popular budget-friendly platform. The new lineup includes the 305P MkIII, 306P MkIII, and 308P MkIII two-way monitors with driver sizes ranging from 5 to 8 inches, along with the matching 310S MkIII powered subwoofer.

This generation marks the first time the series utilizes Class D amplification, which delivers higher output volume, increased headroom, and reduced functional noise. The monitors also feature rebuilt tweeters and woofers, updated Image Control Waveguides, integrated mounting provisions, and four one-touch room controls providing 81 corrective EQ combinations without requiring external software.

entry.content:

Ueberschall has released two new sample library collections, the Disco Bundle and the LoFi Bundle, designed for its Elastik loop player and Downloader app. The Disco Bundle includes 9 GB of content across four products—Disco Classics, Disco Classics 2, Electric Disco, and DiscoTape—featuring over 1,900 loops and samples split across 30 construction kits.

The LoFi Bundle offers approximately 15 GB of content combining four other libraries: LoFi Beats, LoFi Lounge, Noise Floor, and Jazz Trip. It incorporates over 3,200 loops and samples across 40 construction kits blending jazz, hip-hop, downtempo, and lounge elements. Both bundles are sold at discounted rates compared to purchasing the individual libraries separately.
